subject: Implement Pydantic settings configuration system
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/config.py` with Pydantic settings for HANA connection configuration.

Must implement:
- Env var prefix: `MAMBA_MCP_HANA_*`
- Nested model structure with `__` delimiter support
- Database settings: `DB_HOST` (default: localhost), `DB_PORT` (default: 30015), `DB_NAME` (optional), `DB_USER` (required), `DB_PASSWORD` (SecretStr, required), `DB_ENCRYPT` (auto-detect), `DB_SSL_VALIDATE` (default: True), `DB_USERKEY` (optional hdbuserstore key)
- Server settings: `TRANSPORT` (stdio/http, default: stdio), `SERVER_HOST` (default: 0.0.0.0), `SERVER_PORT` (default: 8080), `LOG_LEVEL` (default: INFO), `LOG_FORMAT` (default: json)
- Pool settings: `POOL_SIZE` (default: 5, range 1-20), `POOL_TIMEOUT` (default: 30.0)
- Query settings: `STATEMENT_TIMEOUT` (default: 30000ms), `DEFAULT_SCHEMA` (optional)
- Cascading env file resolution: explicit path > `./mamba.env` > `~/mamba.env`
- Auto-detect TLS when port is 443 (HANA Cloud), allow manual override

Reference: mamba-mcp-postgres `config.py` for patterns.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] All env vars from spec appendix 13.4 are supported
- [ ] `DB_PASSWORD` stored as Pydantic `SecretStr`, never logged
- [ ] Auto-TLS detection: port 443 → `DB_ENCRYPT=True` unless manually overridden
- [ ] Nested delimiter `__` works (e.g., `MAMBA_MCP_HANA_DB__HOST`)
- [ ] Env file cascading: explicit > `./mamba.env` > `~/mamba.env`

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `DB_USERKEY` provided without `DB_USER`/`DB_PASSWORD`: valid (hdbuserstore auth)
- [ ] Both `DB_USERKEY` and `DB_USER`/`DB_PASSWORD` provided: user/password takes precedence
- [ ] `POOL_SIZE` outside range 1-20: validation error

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Missing required fields raise clear validation errors
- [ ] Invalid env file path raises FileNotFoundError with descriptive message

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Config loads from env vars correctly
• Unit: Auto-TLS detection for port 443
• Unit: Env file cascading resolution order
• Unit: SecretStr does not leak in repr/str
• Unit: Validation rejects invalid pool size

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.5, 13.4
